text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years with Meisho Doto 
were a massive success. We were able to 
achieve wonderful results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, behind the scenes, there was 
something that had been said all along...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If only T.M. Opera O hadn't been there, 
she could have shone even brighter. Would 
the era not have been split in two?" they 
say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—a major turning point arrived.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! A proposition! To help Meisho 
Doto shine even brighter—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"An overseas expedition! Do you have any 
interest in letting her challenge races 
abroad?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Meisho Doto and TM Opera O. Some say 
it is a shame to pit the two against each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Both are worthy of being the lead! We 
could also dare to take a different path 
entirely. Would you consider that for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without having sorted out my thoughts, I 
decided to talk with Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, an overseas performance, huh. It's 
fine for stellar actors to co-star like 
this, but having one of them always 
relegated to a supporting role would be a 
shame.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Chairwoman. From my 
perspective too, I believe the era should 
pay even more attention to Doto.
choice_data_list: What do you think, Meisho Doto?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto, who is normally so flustered, 
is uncharacteristically quiet. She ponders 
deeply, and then—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: An era...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: An era... My era... Opera O-san's era...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If we split it into two, it doubles, and 
both of us will be even happier...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Is that... what it is?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I... don't want to.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?! Doto, are you saying you refuse?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her tone was clear and decisive, 
uncharacteristic of Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"If I hadn't been around, would Opera 
O-san have been able to achieve even 
more?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If Opera O-san wasn't around, would I have 
won more?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't think so. It was because Opera 
O-san was there that I was able to grow 
strong...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's because I was there that Opera O-san 
...became the Opera O-san she is today, 
I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"We're not the same as we used to be. We 
went from being dead weight to rivals, 
but... even if we're apart, it's not like 
the burden doubles."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If we're apart, I wouldn't be me, and 
Opera O wouldn't be Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's not 'if that person wasn't 
there'—it's 'because that person was 
there' that we can keep moving forward 
from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's why...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Is that really alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words, I became certain. 
There are things you just can't understand 
from the outside looking in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something that can never be divided. 
Indivisible. Otherwise, there's no way 
these past three years could have shone 
this brightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—their race continues!

text_block_list.name: Dotou & Opera O
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaahhhhhh! HAAAAAAAAAAAAHH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, next time... next time, I 
won't lose either, Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come at me, Doto! Unchanging for life! 
Engraved by destiny, my eternal rival!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, once again, the fans go wild over 
the two's close battle. Yes, right now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The era of Meisho Doto and T.M. Opera O. 
It is precisely because they were together 
that it continues to shine brightly and 
passionately in Umamusume history.
